sourceAttribution: Reviewed dirty candidate based on current master; source identity is the 505-file manifest, not base HEAD alone. Final commit/CI identity recorded in the draft PR.

independentReview.report: 最终整合复核通过，当前无阻塞问题。Pace 核心、bootstrap、依赖及锁文件与基准 HEAD 一致；导航文件仅追加 charts。正文扩展功能未被取消。两个加载器修复、跨午夜迁移修复完整保留。已修复 interaction:collapse-code 的旧配置指针及验收场景。针对性测试 33/33，矩阵检查 897 条通过，保留既有正式裁定。

fixedFindings.problem: Legacy cross-midnight night windows were reversed.
fixedFindings.fix: Compare original endpoints before modulo 24; swap daylight windows, preserve night windows; report unrepresentable windows. Exhaustive endpoint/hour equivalence tests.

fixedFindings.problem: Body renderer and gallery private loaders retried local scripts after timeout, risking duplicate execution.
fixedFindings.fix: Use common managed loader; fall back only on definite native error or unusable API. Cache timeout, reuse late SDK; allow renderer manual retry after definite error.

fixedFindings.problem: New master collapse-code matrix still referenced removed render.enable_code_expander.
fixedFindings.fix: Map to render.code_shrink and explicit expanded/collapsed/disabled cases.

independentReview.finalWhitespaceCleanup: Removed whitespace-only line in charts.ts after staged diff check; no executable code or generated package change.
